verdict.rationale: Lithic's sandbox has dedicated endpoints to simulate transaction events originating from a merchant acquirer, including authorization requests from the payment network. It is described as mirroring production end-to-end for cards, transactions, and webhooks. Those simulated authorizations can be run against ASA endpoints and Auth Rules, so decisioning logic can be tested before going live. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of simulation endpoints for clearings, reversals, refunds, and declines specifically; independent or hands-on corroboration.
